name: plastics+: the study PM has fiber, cooling and warpage groups; turning them on shows their inputs
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const P = m.mfg.plastics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no field ' + k); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const tog = (k) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-toggle="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no toggle ' + k); i.click(); }; await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('basMountBracket'); await sleep(1500); await m.run('plasticsStudy'); await sleep(300); P.study().cells = 24; const before = { coolInputs: Boolean(q('[data-pm-field="plChFlow"]')), warpInputs: Boolean(q('[data-pm-field="plWarpSize"]')) }; fld('plFiber', 30); await sleep(200); tog('plCoolOn'); await sleep(200); tog('plWarpOn'); await sleep(200); fld('plChFlow', 8); await sleep(150); const s = P.study(); return JSON.stringify({ ...before, fiber: s.fiber, cooling: s.cooling.on, flow: s.cooling.flow, warp: s.warp.on, aspect: Boolean(q('[data-pm-field="plAspect"]')), coolant: Boolean(q('[data-pm-select="plCoolant"]')), steel: Boolean(q('[data-pm-select="plSteel"]')) }); })()

name: plastics+: one run in the worker gives the fill, the fiber orientation, the cooling of two circuits and the warpage by cause
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const P = m.mfg.plastics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no field ' + k); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const tog = (k) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-toggle="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no toggle ' + k); i.click(); }; const r = await P.run(); await sleep(300); const lines = [...document.querySelectorAll('.left-pm-body .mfg-results li')].map((li) => li.textContent); const seg = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-set="plQuantity"]')].map((b) => b.dataset.value); return JSON.stringify({ filled: !r.summary.shortShot, fibers: r.fibers.mean > 0.34, circuits: r.cooling.circuits.length, wall: r.cooling.summary.wallMin > 20 && r.cooling.summary.wallMax < 120, warp: r.warp.cases.total.warpMax > 0 && r.warp.cases.total.max >= r.warp.cases.total.warpMax, causes: ['shrinkage', 'cooling', 'orientation'].every((c) => Number.isFinite(r.warp.cases[c].warpMax)), seg: ['mouldTemp', 'coolTime', 'fiberAlign', 'warp'].every((x) => seg.includes(x)), circuitLines: document.querySelectorAll('.left-pm-body li.pl-circuit').length, warpLine: lines.some((l) => /휨|Warpage/.test(l)) }); })()

name: plastics+: mould wall temperature colours the part and draws the channels; fiber alignment colours it too
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const P = m.mfg.plastics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no field ' + k); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const tog = (k) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-toggle="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no toggle ' + k); i.click(); }; m.actions.pmSet('plQuantity', 'mouldTemp'); await sleep(500); const g = m.viewport.groups.mfgPl; const lines = g.children.filter((o) => o.isLineSegments2 || o.type === 'LineSegments2').length; const body = m.viewport.bodies.get('body'); const col = body?.mesh.geometry.getAttribute('color'); const legend = q('.pl-legend')?.textContent ?? ''; m.actions.pmSet('plQuantity', 'fiberAlign'); await sleep(400); const legend2 = q('.pl-legend')?.textContent ?? 'none'; return JSON.stringify({ lines, coloured: Boolean(col && col.count > 0), unit: /°C/.test(legend), fiberLegend: legend2 === 'none' || !/°C/.test(legend2) }); })()

name: plastics+: warpage by cause, with the deformed shape exaggerated by the scale
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const P = m.mfg.plastics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no field ' + k); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const tog = (k) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-toggle="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no toggle ' + k); i.click(); }; m.actions.pmSet('plQuantity', 'warp'); await sleep(400); const pos0 = Float32Array.from(m.viewport.bodies.get('body').mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array); m.actions.pmSet('plWarpCause', 'orientation'); await sleep(300); tog('plDeformed'); await sleep(500); const scaleField = q('[data-pm-field="plWarpScale"]'); const pos1 = m.viewport.bodies.get('body').mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array; let moved = 0; for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(pos0.length, pos1.length); i++) moved = Math.max(moved, Math.abs(pos1[i] - pos0[i])); fld('plWarpScale', 1); await sleep(400); const pos2 = m.viewport.bodies.get('body').mesh.geometry.getAttribute('position').array; let moved2 = 0; for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(pos0.length, pos2.length); i++) moved2 = Math.max(moved2, Math.abs(pos2[i] - pos0[i])); const legend = q('.pl-legend')?.textContent ?? ''; return JSON.stringify({ legendMm: /mm/.test(legend), scale: Boolean(scaleField), deformed: moved > 0.5, lessAtScale1: moved2 < moved, causeSeg: document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-set="plWarpCause"]').length }); })()

name: plastics+: the report has the fiber, cooling and warpage sections; the toolbar commands exist
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const P = m.mfg.plastics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no field ' + k); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const tog = (k) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-toggle="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no toggle ' + k); i.click(); }; let got = null; P.setSaveHook((c) => { got = c; }); await P.saveReport(); const html = String(got ?? ''); return JSON.stringify({ fiber: /C_I/.test(html), cooling: /Re<\/th>/.test(html) && /kPa/.test(html), warp: /mm<\/td>/.test(html) && (/Main cause|주된 원인/.test(html)), commands: ['plFiber', 'plCooling', 'plWarp'].every((c) => Boolean(m.commands[c])) }); })()

name: plastics+: turning cooling and warpage off again runs only the fill (no stale extra results)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const P = m.mfg.plastics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no field ' + k); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; const tog = (k) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-toggle="${k}"]`); if (!i) throw new Error('no toggle ' + k); i.click(); }; tog('plCoolOn'); await sleep(150); tog('plWarpOn'); await sleep(150); fld('plFiber', 0); await sleep(150); const r = await P.run(); await m.run('plasticsStudy'); await sleep(200); return JSON.stringify({ cooling: r.cooling === undefined, warp: r.warp === undefined, fibers: r.fibers === undefined, closed: m.state.editing?.mode ?? null }); })()
